name: XCC_CF_TRANSACTIONS
description: This table contains purchase orders processed by the carry forward enterprise service scheduler process for final close and reopen actions. The Carry Forward Results Report uses this data to show the results of the carry forward enterprise service scheduler process. Data in this table is purged at a later time by the archive and purge process.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PO_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Purchase order document header unique identifier. References PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID.

columns.name: PO_LINE_ID
columns.description: Purchase order document line unique identifier. References PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID.

columns.name: PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Purchase order shipment schedule unique identifier. References PO_LINE_LOCATION_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID.

columns.name: CF_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Carry forward transaction action. Valid values are CF_FINALLY_CLOSE_PO and CF_REOPEN_PO.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Budgetary control data set identifier for this transaction.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Resulting status of the carry forward transaction action.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CF_BUDGET_BALANCE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the budget is to be carried forward along with the encumbered purchase order.
